title: ConnectorManifest
description: Registration manifest for one connector (NS-09): capabilities, permission scopes, data granularity, freshness, rate limits, credential references, advisory flag and write support. No member can hold a secret value: there is no free-text field, credentials are Key Vault secret identifiers (vault_ref) validated by pattern, and URLs cannot carry query strings, fragments or userinfo (so no SAS or signed URLs). Read-only connectors are advisory; only connectors with write support can back the action executor (PRP-17). Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by the Python validator check_connector_manifest in tests/contracts/test_connector_manifest.py (PRP-01 item 7): credential_refs names are unique; no pattern-constrained string (scopes, names) contains high-entropy or known secret-prefix material; a vault_ref host matches a cloud listed in supported_clouds (vault.azure.net for commercial, vault.usgovcloudapi.net for government).

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document (semver within major 1).

documentation_url.description: HTTPS documentation URL. No query string, fragment or userinfo.

supported_clouds.description: Azure clouds this connector registration may run in. A registration never moves data between clouds.

capabilities.description: What the connector can provide or do.

scopes.description: Permission scopes or roles the connector requests (for example Reports.Read.All or https://management.azure.com/.default). Names only, never values.

granularity.description: Finest grain of data the connector delivers.

freshness.description: Expected delay between source event and availability, in integer milliseconds. null = unknown, never 0.

rate_limits.description: Published source rate limits; null = unknown, empty array = source publishes none.

auth_mode.description: managed_identity and workload_identity_federation carry no credential_refs; vault_reference requires at least one.

credential_refs.description: Credentials by reference only. There is deliberately no field for a credential value.

advisory.description: true = recommendations from this connector are advisory only (no executable actions). Must be true exactly when write_support.supported is false.

name.description: Logical credential name used by the connector code.

vault_ref.description: Azure Key Vault secret identifier: https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/<name>[/<version>] or the vault.usgovcloudapi.net equivalent. Resolved at runtime by managed identity; the value never appears in a manifest, prompt or log.

actions.description: Action kinds the connector can execute through the shared action executor. Empty when supported is false.
